name: superbased-observer-apps
description: npm workspace root for the application UI surfaces (web, web2, webcloud) and the shared design system (shared/). Not a Go concern; the Go module is defined by go.mod. The dependencies below are the shared design-system's runtime peers, declared here so they hoist to the root node_modules that shared/ resolves against; each app also declares the ones it uses and resolve.dedupe keeps a single React instance.
